missionParams:

Split the battlefield into four numbered Quarters as shown on the Deployment Card (1–4).

Lava Surge (Before Scoring):
At the end of each round, roll 1D6:
1–4: All units fully or partially in the corresponding Quarter take D3 damage.
5: All units fully or partially around 3" Mission Marker 5 take D3 damage.
6: All units on the battlefield take D3 damage.
Exceptions: Flying units and units on terrain 3" or higher are unaffected.

additionalConditions:
All mission markers are crystals.  Crystals are tokens with DISPLACEMENT. If displaced that unit picks up the crystal instead. After any move ability if any model is in base contact with a friendly player edge remove that unit from the battlefield and return it to reserves along with any crystals they were carrying.  When any unit is destroyed instead of being removed from the game they return to reserves as if they were never deployed. If they were carrying crystals, then select a leading model and place all of the crystals in coherency. 
The game ends immediately if all crystals are in player reserves.
